from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Border, Side, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import LineChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.label import DataLabelList
from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import CellIsRule
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from openpyxl.worksheet.table import Table, TableStyleInfo
from openpyxl.chart.axis import ChartLines

OUT = Path('电商店铺月度经营数据.xlsx')

months = [f'{i}月' for i in range(1, 13)]
last_year = {
    '访客数': [82000, 78000, 91000, 96000, 108000, 115000, 122000, 118000, 130000, 145000, 168000, 210000],
    '转化率': [0.031, 0.029, 0.032, 0.034, 0.035, 0.036, 0.035, 0.034, 0.037, 0.039, 0.041, 0.045],
    '客单价': [268, 272, 265, 270, 276, 280, 278, 275, 282, 288, 295, 305],
    '退款率': [0.082, 0.079, 0.081, 0.078, 0.075, 0.073, 0.076, 0.078, 0.074, 0.072, 0.070, 0.068],
}
this_year = {
    '访客数': [90000, 86000, 98000, 105000, 118000, 126000, 134000, 129000, 143000, 160000, 188000, 236000],
    '转化率': [0.034, 0.032, 0.035, 0.037, 0.039, 0.040, 0.039, 0.038, 0.041, 0.043, 0.046, 0.050],
    '客单价': [275, 278, 272, 278, 284, 288, 286, 282, 290, 296, 305, 318],
    '退款率': [0.078, 0.075, 0.077, 0.074, 0.071, 0.069, 0.071, 0.073, 0.069, 0.067, 0.065, 0.062],
}

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = '月度经营数据'
input_ws = wb.create_sheet('数据录入')
info_ws = wb.create_sheet('指标说明')
dashboard_ws = wb.create_sheet('KPI仪表盘', 0)

# Theme
navy = '1F4E78'
blue = 'D9EAF7'
light_blue = 'EAF3F8'
header_blue = '5B9BD5'
green = 'E2F0D9'
red = 'FCE4D6'
gray = 'F2F2F2'
dark = '1F2937'
white = 'FFFFFF'
thin_gray = Side(style='thin', color='D9E1F2')
medium_blue = Side(style='medium', color=navy)

currency_fmt = '¥#,##0.00'
integer_fmt = '#,##0'
percent_fmt = '0.0%'
change_fmt = '+0.0%;-0.0%;—'

# Data entry sheet
input_ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
input_ws.freeze_panes = 'A5'
input_ws.merge_cells('A1:F1')
input_ws['A1'] = '数据录入｜可替换示例数据'
input_ws['A1'].font = Font(size=16, bold=True, color=white)
input_ws['A1'].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
input_ws['A1'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
input_ws['A2'] = '替换黄色单元格中的本年度/上年度原始数据，主表公式与图表将自动更新。销售额由访客数×转化率×客单价计算。'
input_ws.merge_cells('A2:F2')
input_ws['A2'].font = Font(color='666666', italic=True)
input_ws['A2'].alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)
input_ws['A4'] = '本年度示例数据'
input_ws['A4'].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
input_ws['H4'] = '上年度示例数据'
input_ws['H4'].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
headers = ['月份', '访客数', '转化率', '客单价（元）', '退款率', '销售额（元）']
for c, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = input_ws.cell(5, c, h)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=header_blue)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
for c, h in enumerate(headers, 8):
    cell = input_ws.cell(5, c, h)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')

for i, month in enumerate(months, 6):
    input_ws.cell(i, 1, month)
    input_ws.cell(i, 2, this_year['访客数'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 3, this_year['转化率'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 4, this_year['客单价'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 5, this_year['退款率'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 6, f'=B{i}*C{i}*D{i}')
    input_ws.cell(i, 8, month)
    input_ws.cell(i, 9, last_year['访客数'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 10, last_year['转化率'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 11, last_year['客单价'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 12, last_year['退款率'][i-6])
    input_ws.cell(i, 13, f'=I{i}*J{i}*K{i}')
    for c in [2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12]:
        input_ws.cell(i, c).fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FFF2CC')
    for c in [6, 13]:
        input_ws.cell(i, c).fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=light_blue)

for row in input_ws.iter_rows(min_row=6, max_row=17):
    for cell in row:
        cell.border = Border(bottom=thin_gray)
        if cell.column in [3, 5, 10, 12]: cell.number_format = percent_fmt
        elif cell.column in [4, 6, 11, 13]: cell.number_format = currency_fmt
        elif cell.column in [2, 9]: cell.number_format = integer_fmt

# validation
rate_validation = DataValidation(type='decimal', operator='between', formula1=0, formula2=1, allow_blank=False)
rate_validation.error = '请输入 0% 至 100% 之间的比例。'
rate_validation.errorTitle = '比例格式错误'
rate_validation.prompt = '请输入 0 到 1 之间的小数，例如 3.5% 输入 0.035。'
rate_validation.promptTitle = '请输入比例'
input_ws.add_data_validation(rate_validation)
for rng in ['C6:C17', 'E6:E17', 'J6:J17', 'L6:L17']:
    rate_validation.add(rng)

for col, width in {'A':10,'B':13,'C':12,'D':15,'E':12,'F':16,'H':10,'I':13,'J':12,'K':15,'L':12,'M':16}.items():
    input_ws.column_dimensions[col].width = width
input_ws.auto_filter.ref = 'A5:F17'
input_ws.auto_filter.add_filter_column(0, months)

# Tables (one per period)
for ref, name in [('A5:F17','CurrentYearInput'), ('H5:M17','PriorYearInput')]:
    tab = Table(displayName=name, ref=ref)
    tab.tableStyleInfo = TableStyleInfo(name='TableStyleMedium2', showRowStripes=True, showColumnStripes=False)
    input_ws.add_table(tab)

# Main sheet
ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws.freeze_panes = 'B5'
ws.merge_cells('A1:O1')
ws['A1'] = '电商店铺月度经营数据分析'
ws['A1'].font = Font(size=18, bold=True, color=white)
ws['A1'].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
ws['A1'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
ws.merge_cells('A2:O2')
ws['A2'] = '口径：销售额=访客数×转化率×客单价；同比=本年度同月÷上年度同月-1；环比=本月÷上月-1。'
ws['A2'].font = Font(color='666666', italic=True)
ws['A2'].alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)

# Group headers
ws['A4'] = '月份'
ws.merge_cells('B3:F3'); ws['B3'] = '本年度'
ws.merge_cells('G3:K3'); ws['G3'] = '同比'
ws.merge_cells('L3:P3'); ws['L3'] = '环比'
ws.merge_cells('Q3:U3'); ws['Q3'] = '上年度'
for cell in ['A4','B3','G3','L3','Q3']:
    ws[cell].font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
    ws[cell].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
    ws[cell].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
# subheaders
metric_names = ['访客数','转化率','客单价','销售额','退款率']
for start in [2, 7, 12, 17]:
    for idx, name in enumerate(metric_names):
        cell = ws.cell(4, start + idx, name if start == 2 or start == 17 else f'{name}变化')
        cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
        cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=header_blue if start in [2,12] else navy)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', wrap_text=True)
ws['A4'].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
ws['A4'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')

for r, month in enumerate(months, 5):
    src = r + 1
    ws.cell(r, 1, month)
    # current year from input
    for col, input_col in zip(range(2,7), ['B','C','D','F','E']):
        ws.cell(r, col, f"='数据录入'!{input_col}{src}")
    # YoY against prior year (same month)
    for col, current_col, prior_col in zip(range(7,12), range(2,7), range(17,22)):
        ws.cell(r, col, f'=IFERROR({get_column_letter(current_col)}{r}/{get_column_letter(prior_col)}{r}-1,"")')
    # MoM; first month displays em dash
    for col, current_col in zip(range(12,17), range(2,7)):
        if r == 5:
            ws.cell(r, col, '—')
        else:
            ws.cell(r, col, f'=IFERROR({get_column_letter(current_col)}{r}/{get_column_letter(current_col)}{r-1}-1,"")')
    # prior year from input
    for col, input_col in zip(range(17,22), ['I','J','K','M','L']):
        ws.cell(r, col, f"='数据录入'!{input_col}{src}")

# formats / borders
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=5, max_row=16, min_col=1, max_col=21):
    for cell in row:
        cell.border = Border(bottom=thin_gray)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right' if cell.column != 1 else 'center')
        if cell.column in [2, 17]: cell.number_format = integer_fmt
        elif cell.column in [3, 21, 8, 13]: cell.number_format = percent_fmt
        elif cell.column in [4, 5, 18, 19]: cell.number_format = currency_fmt
        elif cell.column in [6, 20]: cell.number_format = percent_fmt if cell.column == 20 else currency_fmt
        elif cell.column in list(range(7, 12)) + list(range(12, 17)):
            cell.number_format = change_fmt
# Fix current year formats specifically
for r in range(5,17):
    ws.cell(r,2).number_format = integer_fmt
    ws.cell(r,3).number_format = percent_fmt
    ws.cell(r,4).number_format = currency_fmt
    ws.cell(r,5).number_format = currency_fmt
    ws.cell(r,6).number_format = percent_fmt
    ws.cell(r,17).number_format = integer_fmt
    ws.cell(r,18).number_format = percent_fmt
    ws.cell(r,19).number_format = currency_fmt
    ws.cell(r,20).number_format = currency_fmt
    ws.cell(r,21).number_format = percent_fmt

# conditional formatting for changes
positive_fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='E2F0D9')
negative_fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FCE4D6')
for rng in ['G5:K16', 'L5:P16']:
    ws.conditional_formatting.add(rng, CellIsRule(operator='greaterThan', formula=['0'], fill=positive_fill))
    ws.conditional_formatting.add(rng, CellIsRule(operator='lessThan', formula=['0'], fill=negative_fill))

# widths and outlines
widths = {1:10, 2:13, 3:12, 4:14, 5:16, 6:12}
for c in range(7,17): widths[c] = 12
for c in range(17,22): widths[c] = 13
for c,w in widths.items(): ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(c)].width = w
for row in [3,4]: ws.row_dimensions[row].height = 24
ws.auto_filter.ref = 'A4:U16'
ws.print_area = 'A1:U36'
ws.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'
ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0
ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage = True
ws.sheet_view.zoomScale = 85

# Add charts below table
sales_chart = LineChart()
sales_chart.title = '销售额趋势（元）'
sales_chart.style = 13
sales_chart.y_axis.title = '销售额（元）'
sales_chart.x_axis.title = '月份'
sales_chart.height = 7.5
sales_chart.width = 15
sales_chart.legend.position = 'b'
sales_chart.y_axis.majorGridlines = ChartLines()
# use non-contiguous series explicitly: current sales col E and prior sales col T
sales_chart.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=5, max_col=5, min_row=4, max_row=16), titles_from_data=True)
sales_chart.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=20, max_col=20, min_row=4, max_row=16), titles_from_data=True)
sales_chart.set_categories(Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=5, max_row=16))
sales_chart.series[0].graphicalProperties.line.solidFill = header_blue
sales_chart.series[1].graphicalProperties.line.solidFill = 'A5A5A5'
ws.add_chart(sales_chart, 'A19')

traffic_chart = LineChart()
traffic_chart.title = '访客数与转化率趋势'
traffic_chart.style = 13
traffic_chart.y_axis.title = '访客数'
traffic_chart.x_axis.title = '月份'
traffic_chart.height = 7.5
traffic_chart.width = 15
traffic_chart.legend.position = 'b'
traffic_chart.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_col=3, min_row=4, max_row=16), titles_from_data=True, from_rows=False)
traffic_chart.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=17, max_col=18, min_row=4, max_row=16), titles_from_data=True, from_rows=False)
traffic_chart.set_categories(Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=5, max_row=16))
# secondary axis for percent series if supported
for idx in [1,3]:
    traffic_chart.series[idx].graphicalProperties.line.solidFill = '70AD47' if idx == 1 else 'ED7D31'
ws.add_chart(traffic_chart, 'J19')

# KPI dashboard
 dashboard_ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
 dashboard_ws.freeze_panes = 'A6'
 dashboard_ws.merge_cells('A1:J1')
 dashboard_ws['A1'] = 'KPI仪表盘｜电商店铺月度经营概览'
 dashboard_ws['A1'].font = Font(size=18, bold=True, color=white)
 dashboard_ws['A1'].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
 dashboard_ws['A1'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
 dashboard_ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 30
 dashboard_ws.merge_cells('A2:J2')
 dashboard_ws['A2'] = '展示本年度最新月份的关键指标与环比变化；数据来自“月度经营数据”表，替换“数据录入”后自动更新。'
 dashboard_ws['A2'].font = Font(color='666666', italic=True)
 dashboard_ws['A2'].alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)
 dashboard_ws.merge_cells('A3:J3')
 dashboard_ws['A3'] = '=\"数据截至：\"&\'月度经营数据\'!A16'
 dashboard_ws['A3'].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
 dashboard_ws['A3'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')

 kpi_specs = [
     ('访客数', "='月度经营数据'!B16", "='月度经营数据'!L16", integer_fmt),
     ('转化率', "='月度经营数据'!C16", "='月度经营数据'!M16", percent_fmt),
     ('客单价', "='月度经营数据'!D16", "='月度经营数据'!N16", currency_fmt),
     ('销售额', "='月度经营数据'!E16", "='月度经营数据'!O16", currency_fmt),
     ('退款率', "='月度经营数据'!F16", "='月度经营数据'!P16", percent_fmt),
 ]
 for idx, (label, value_formula, mom_formula, fmt) in enumerate(kpi_specs):
     start_col = 1 + idx * 2
     end_col = start_col + 1
     dashboard_ws.merge_cells(start_row=5, start_column=start_col, end_row=5, end_column=end_col)
     dashboard_ws.merge_cells(start_row=6, start_column=start_col, end_row=6, end_column=end_col)
     dashboard_ws.merge_cells(start_row=7, start_column=start_col, end_row=7, end_column=end_col)
     label_cell = dashboard_ws.cell(5, start_col, label)
     label_cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
     label_cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=header_blue)
     label_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
     value_cell = dashboard_ws.cell(6, start_col, value_formula)
     value_cell.font = Font(size=16, bold=True, color=dark)
     value_cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=light_blue)
     value_cell.number_format = fmt
     value_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
     mom_label = dashboard_ws.cell(7, start_col, '环比')
     mom_label.font = Font(color='666666')
     mom_label.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=gray)
     mom_label.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
     mom_cell = dashboard_ws.cell(7, end_col, mom_formula)
     mom_cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=dark)
     mom_cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=gray)
     mom_cell.number_format = change_fmt
     mom_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
     dashboard_ws.conditional_formatting.add(mom_cell.coordinate, CellIsRule(operator='greaterThan', formula=['0'], fill=positive_fill))
     dashboard_ws.conditional_formatting.add(mom_cell.coordinate, CellIsRule(operator='lessThan', formula=['0'], fill=negative_fill))

 dashboard_ws['A9'] = '经营趋势'
 dashboard_ws['A9'].font = Font(size=13, bold=True, color=navy)
 dashboard_ws['A10'] = '可结合下方趋势图观察本年度与上年度的销售额、流量和转化表现。'
 dashboard_ws['A10'].font = Font(color='666666')
 dashboard_ws.merge_cells('A10:J10')
 dashboard_ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 16
 for col in ['B','C','D','E','F','G','H','I','J']:
     dashboard_ws.column_dimensions[col].width = 13
 dashboard_ws.row_dimensions[6].height = 30
 dashboard_ws.row_dimensions[7].height = 22
 dashboard_ws.print_area = 'A1:J10'
 dashboard_ws.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'
 dashboard_ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
 dashboard_ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage = True

 # info sheet
 info_ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
info_ws.merge_cells('A1:D1')
info_ws['A1'] = '指标说明与使用说明'
info_ws['A1'].font = Font(size=16, bold=True, color=white)
info_ws['A1'].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
info_ws['A2'] = '使用时请优先修改“数据录入”表中的黄色单元格；主表公式和图表无需手动调整。'
info_ws.merge_cells('A2:D2')
info_ws['A2'].font = Font(color='666666', italic=True)
for c,h in enumerate(['字段','定义/口径','计算方式','数据位置'],1):
    cell = info_ws.cell(4,c,h)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True,color=white)
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid',fgColor=header_blue)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', wrap_text=True)
rows = [
    ['访客数','统计周期内进入店铺的访问人数','原始录入，单位：人','数据录入 B/I 列'],
    ['转化率','访客转化为付款订单的比例','原始录入，范围 0% 至 100%','数据录入 C/J 列'],
    ['客单价','每笔付款订单的平均成交金额','原始录入，单位：元','数据录入 D/K 列'],
    ['销售额','按经营模型估算的成交金额','访客数×转化率×客单价','数据录入 F/M 列自动计算'],
    ['退款率','退款金额或退款订单占比的经营指标','原始录入，范围 0% 至 100%','数据录入 E/L 列'],
    ['同比','与上年度同月比较的变化率','本年度同月÷上年度同月-1','主表 G:K 列自动计算'],
    ['环比','与本年度上一个月比较的变化率','本月÷上月-1；1月显示“—”','主表 L:P 列自动计算'],
]
for r, row in enumerate(rows,5):
    for c, value in enumerate(row,1):
        cell = info_ws.cell(r,c,value)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical='top', wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = Border(bottom=thin_gray)
        if r % 2 == 0: cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=gray)
for col, width in {'A':14,'B':34,'C':34,'D':28}.items(): info_ws.column_dimensions[col].width = width
for r in range(5,12): info_ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 36
info_ws['A14'] = '注意事项'
info_ws['A14'].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
notes = [
    '1. 示例数据用于演示，替换时请保持字段含义和单位一致。',
    '2. 转化率与退款率设置了 0% 至 100% 的数据验证。',
    '3. 主表同比/环比是百分比变化率，不是百分点变化。',
    '4. 图表引用主表的 12 个月序列，替换数据后会随公式结果更新。',
]
for i, note in enumerate(notes,15): info_ws.cell(i,1,note); info_ws.merge_cells(start_row=i,start_column=1,end_row=i,end_column=4)

# workbook properties / active sheet
wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
wb.calculation.calcMode = 'auto'
wb.active = 0
wb.save(OUT)
print(OUT)
